purpose: Five face-icon variations derived from approved concept 03

variants.name: 기본형
variants.prompt:
Create a polished square 1024 by 1024 bitmap ICON DESIGN SPECIMEN for the Cleany facility robot dashboard. The user selected option 03, the tiny navy-and-yellow smiling FACE MAP MARKER, in the first reference image. Develop that face icon only; do not redraw the dashboard, floor plan, 3D robot, or a full user interface. The second reference is the actual existing Cleany brand face: preserve its recognizability, restrained friendliness, navy/white/yellow identity and yellow right-hand casing accent.

Consistent specimen composition: flat near-white background (#F7F9FB), generous clean spacing, small upper-left number and short title supplied below in navy sans-serif; one large exact flat vector-style icon centered in the upper middle, approximately 380px wide; beneath it a very faint short divider and a row of three precisely matching smaller repetitions of this SAME icon at approximately 28px, 40px and 56px, horizontally separated, with only the numbers '28', '40', '56' below them. Keep the tiny samples actually small. All repeated icons must use the identical design and expression. The face interior is opaque warm white, not transparent/checkered. Edges must be clean, mathematically smooth, balanced, professional and readable at 24–32px. This is a restrained functional robot map icon, not a toy sticker or an emoji. Use navy #08284D, warm white #FDFDF9, and a small sunny yellow #FFC928 accent. No outer circular badge, no surrounding disk or extra container, no halo/ring, no floor shadow, no glow, no gradients, no 3D, no antenna, no wheels, no arms, no cheeks, no stars, no name tag, and no floating status dot. The robot's own head outline is the entire icon silhouette. No additional words beyond the specified number/title and the three size numbers. Avoid watermarks.

VARIANT-SPECIFIC DESIGN:
Title exactly '01  CLASSIC'. Develop the closest refinement of selected concept 03: a gently rounded rectangular head, face housing width-to-height ratio about 1.12, even medium navy outline equivalent to 2px at 28px, white screen, two upright short navy pill eyes with carefully balanced spacing and a small shallow U-shaped smile. A narrow yellow vertical capsule is attached immediately to the right side, about 45 percent of face height, outlined with navy and contained close to the main housing. This right accent must read as functional side casing and add very little width. Clear classic Cleany silhouette, mildly friendly, optical balance.
